headline: Marvel's Vision Quest still timeless 37 years later
post:
Thirty-seven years after its debut, Marvel's original "Vision Quest" storyline remains a timeless classic that is well worth revisiting. According to Screen Rant, this iconic 1989 comic arc from writer and artist John Byrne fundamentally reshaped the dynamic between Wanda Maximoff and Vision. The story kicked off when government forces captured and dismantled the hero, leading to his return as the emotionless "White Vision" and altering his origins involving the original Human Torch.

Today, the influence of those pages shines brightly across the MCU. From 2021's WandaVision to the streaming platform and the ongoing "VisionQuest" series currently airing on Disney+, so many of those foundational comic ideas have been brilliantly adapted for the screen. It is fascinating to see how modern shows continue to honor and rework these classic status-quo-changing comic events.

Have you gone back to read the original comics yet?

#Marvel #VisionQuest #WandaVision
original_title: 37 Years Later, Marvel's Original Vision Quest Series Is Still A Timeless Classic
